# democraft-mcp - llms.txt

Demo fleet for the 13 ArtCraft apps. One MCP portmanteau (`craft`), one page
per app, every demo a real headless CLI run plus a local Ollama step.

- Docs: `docs/ONBOARDING.md` (start), `docs/TOOLS.md` (tool reference)
- Server: `src/democraft_mcp/server.py` (MCP), `api.py` (REST), `crafts.py` (registry+runners)
- Webapp: `web_sota/` (React+Vite+Tailwind, catch-them-all + 13 craft pages)
- Full text: `llms-full.txt`
